title: every value of a log line, decoded then scrubbed (D-1358)

findings.claim: a service's log line kept a secret behind two to four percent layers or written password=, and an e-mail address written %40 or @ (the bench: 150 of 150 each); fixed: every line with an encoded character is decoded (tb_common.decode_scrub, shared with the support bundle) before the rules read it

the review's R22-21, confirmed with one correction: extra= values that are objects, dataclasses, exceptions or bytes, and a value under a secret's name in a mapping, went out as written (dicts, lists and tuples of text were already scrubbed); fixed: every value is walked or turned to text and scrubbed, keys too, bounded by depth, count and cycles

the review's R22-22, confirmed: a tuple as a dict key in an extra, or a broken format string, raised in the formatter, and the logging module printed the record's raw arguments to the error stream; fixed: the formatter never raises and writes a withheld line with the logger and the level

the support bundle's rules read the encoded text before its decoded pass: a percent-encoded entity holding an eight-digit run, with a site chart rule, kept the secret in 37 of 150 fuzz cases; closed by H-76 step 0 (decoded view before the raw rules, encoded form kept when the raw rules mask it all), merged into this card: 0 of 150 in all eight classes on the merged tree

pseudonyms and screening numbers are not masked in a service's log line, by design (logs carry pids; test_ordinary_words_are_kept asserts a 32-digit pid stays); ruled by the integrator on 2026-11-22 12:50 UTC: logs keep the pseudonym inside the box, the bundle masks it; a pseudonym is not an identifier outside the box only if the key that makes it stays in the box (D-1358)
findings.state: not a defect: the integrator's ruling of 2026-11-22 12:50 UTC (D-1358)

findings.claim: the log rule's secret names are fewer than the bundle's: a value after cookie, session, dsn, auth or pin is not masked in a log line (it is in a bundle); one name list for both is not built
